Frequency once per round

Trigger A creature within 30 feet whose level is at least your level - 3 is reduced to 0 Hit Points by your Rite or your attack.

Hungry-flavored, open to all — drain vitality from a defeated foe directly into your Zeal.

Gain 1 Zeal, which may exceed your normal maximum by up to 2 points. Excess Zeal above your maximum is lost after 1 minute. You also gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level, which last 1 minute. Something in you enjoys this and it is not entirely you.
